Legend:
- Brick wall: blocked
- Sand floor: walkable
- Small person: player start
- Wooden crate with X: box
- Green X: target

2) If the player moves into the box, the box is pushed one cell in the same direction.
3) A push is valid only when the destination cell of the box is not a wall.
4) No diagonal movement.

Goal:
Push the box onto the green X target.

Output strictly as:
<ANSWER_JSON>["up","right","down",...]</ANSWER_JSON>
Do not output any extra text.
